candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially separate ex-ante evidence from completed-path hindsight and allow each cited observation to be aligned with the forecast or review that used it.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen evidence and candidate issuance ledger
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate issue times, evidence cutoffs, point-in-time feature snapshots, and the complete candidate objects are absent or inconsistently retained, preventing hindsight-leakage and sequence audits.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether repeated proxy breadth deterioration or recovery preceded price moves and whether changing membership or endpoint readings created false impressions of broad participation.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped breadth history with universe and methodology metadata
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only point-in-time Top-100 proxy readings are supplied; the historical path, stable-universe counterpart, construction, weighting, and timestamps needed to assess persistence and representativeness are missing.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would determine whether settled fund demand persisted through the disputed pullback and whether flows led, followed, or failed to support price and breadth.
candidates.metric_name: Settled BTC and ETH ETF flow sequence
candidates.missing_history_problem: The analyses repeatedly rely on stale or isolated settled rows; a complete prior-session sequence with settlement dates, asset coverage, and timestamps is unavailable, so flow persistence and event ordering cannot be evaluated.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish deleveraging or short covering from new short formation and test whether leverage and liquidity deterioration led or merely accompanied price weakness.
candidates.metric_name: Instrumented leverage, positioning, liquidation, and microstructure history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Open-interest and liquidation observations are selected, lower-bound, and poorly specified; the historical venue/instrument composition, long-short direction, completeness, and aligned depth/flow path are missing.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would quantify false positives, false negatives, broad-range containment, post-warning upside, subsequent drawdown, and the symmetric premature- versus late-exit evidence gap.
candidates.metric_name: Matured forecast and warning outcome series
candidates.missing_history_problem: The package reports zero matured warning rows and null or incomplete outcome counts; frozen horizons, target metrics, realized paths, and eligibility status are not available for prior candidates.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether qualitative confidence language has historically corresponded to outcome frequencies and whether mixed evidence was systematically over- or under-confident.
